verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. For each K-rational center, compactly supported tropical test forms convert d'd''[h]=0 into vanishing of the distributional Lagerberg Hessian of the Gauss-section trace. The cited top-form support theorem and multiplicity-one integration formula justify the exact signed-measure reduction to the Gauss section over arbitrary nontrivially valued K. The trace is therefore affine, and convergence as each radius tends to zero forces every slope to vanish, giving h(eta_{a,r})=h(a). Translation-invariant common Gauss points compare all K-rational centers, and continuity gives the skeleton-closure conclusion. Berkovich's relative-interior and composition results correctly place the centered punctured polydiscs in the absolute interior of the closed polydisc, after which continuity extends the identity to boundary radii. Over an algebraically closed extension, strict-affinoid rigid-point density, dense strict exhaustion of the open polydisc, and surjectivity of scalar extension descend constancy. Finally, the CLD affined G-tropical functoriality and positivity theorem show that simultaneous psh-ness of h and -h makes the pulled-back Hessian current both positive and negative, hence zero. Every local deduction and every cited hypothesis was checked; no critical error or gap remains.
